sentences: If a frog's heart was removed and put into your chest,
this pea-sized heart couldn't pump enough blood through your body, and your face would turn purple.
So they'd stuff a hundred frog hearts into your chest.
With a hundred hearts pumping at once, you'd leave everyone behind on the track
and leap over hurdles ten feet high, just like a frog.
But when winter came, the race would be over.
That's because a frog's heart has only three chambers, so clean and dirty blood mix together.
And some frogs freeze solid in winter; their hearts stop, then start beating again in spring.
So you'd spend the winter in the fridge, and in spring, pick the race up right where you left off.
